create_transfer.linux_mini_extraction: INPUT.TXT payload is byte-identical; command reports partial because foreign metadata was not restored

path_differential.absolute_source_path: A Z: absolute source pathname left only the 32-byte archive header; trace reached add_path return but not finalize.
path_differential.relative_source_path: The relative INPUT.TXT pathname produced the complete 352-byte archive.
path_differential.classification: The original incomplete-output reproduction is explained by the absolute source path being used as the archive member name and rejected before local-entry bytes are written. The relative-path transfer works; exact runtime diagnostics remain obscured by Wine teardown/console behavior.

instrumented_control_flow.note: Temporary BP_TEST_WIN16_TRACE instrumentation was removed from source and the normal binary rebuilt after tracing.
instrumented_control_flow.meaning: The Win16 main function completed archive finalization, archive close, and file-descriptor close before returning from the create command.
